hero.tagline:
I enjoy taking a problem and turning it into a functional, genuinely useful software solution. I work primarily in full stack development, with a focus on backend systems, databases, and data-driven projects.

I enjoy exploring new technologies, learning things I don't yet know, and continuously improving the projects I build.

about.subtitle: Software Developer & Tech Enthusiast
about.bio1: I care about both the technical side of software development and ensuring that the final product provides real value to its users.
about.bio2: To me, software development is about more than just writing code. Understanding a problem, designing the right solution, and continuously improving the result are the parts of the process I enjoy most.
about.bio3:
I continue to grow by working on a variety of projects and technologies. I am particularly interested in backend development, data, and modern web technologies.

You can view my CV to learn more about my education, experience, and projects.
about.card1Desc: I build fast, responsive, and user-friendly web applications using modern web technologies. I work across both frontend and backend development, building projects from end to end.
about.card2Desc: I enjoy working with data, turning it into meaningful insights, and managing it effectively. I develop projects involving SQL, data analysis, Power BI, and database management.
about.card3Desc: I develop backend applications and APIs, particularly within the C# and .NET ecosystem. I prioritize clean, maintainable solutions tailored to each project's needs.

projects.subtitle: Here are some of the projects I've developed. Each one was carefully crafted with attention to detail, performance, and user experience.
projects.github: Check out my GitHub for more
projects.project1Desc: I developed this project using ASP.NET Core 8.0 and SignalR technologies. In this system designed to streamline restaurant order management, users can access the menu by scanning QR codes, place orders, and make reservations. Orders are sent to the kitchen in real time, while all processes can be managed in real time.
projects.project2Desc: I developed a hotel rental website in N-Tier architecture using Asp.Net Core. I implemented secure user registration and login with Asp.Net Identity and JWT. I managed data with Entity Framework Core. I conducted API tests with Swagger and Postman. I validated user data with Fluent Validation and sent user notifications via a mailing system.
projects.project3Desc: I developed this project myself using React. I integrated OpenAI's DALL·E API to allow users to generate AI-powered images based on the text they type. Thanks to the simple and user-friendly interface, users can enter text and view the images generated by the AI. I made effective use of React component structure and API calls, gaining experience with AI technologies while improving my frontend skills.
